chunks.content: ## Cooperative Fashion C&D and C&M Major at Shanghai University of Engineering Science This section introduces the unique fashion majors in Clothing Design (C&D) and Clothing Merchandising (C&M) established at Shanghai University of Engineering Science, emphasizing the integration of advanced software in fashion education. Shanghai University of Engineering Science has established a fashion C&D (Clothing Design) and C&M (Clothing Merchandising) major, which is the only program of its kind in China. This program incorporates specialized software that streamlines the fashion design process by eliminating many unnecessary and complicated steps. The software allows students to achieve effects equivalent to physical samples without producing them, significantly saving labor and costs. This approach enhances convenience and efficiency in fashion design education. ## Advantages and Features of the Fashion Design Software and Cloud System This section details the technical and operational benefits of the fashion design software and its accompanying cloud system, highlighting speed, virtual market integration, and educational impact. The integrated fashion design software offers notable advantages: - **Convenience and Efficiency**: The software accelerates design workflows by removing the need for physical sample production, reducing both time and material costs. - **Cloud System Features**: - **High Speed**: Results are generated and delivered rapidly, enabling quick presentation to users. - **Virtual Market Integration**: The system provides significant competitive advantages within the virtual fashion market, supporting digital merchandising and marketing. Following the university’s collaboration with the company supplying this software, the entire teaching system has been integrated, setting a foundation for effective student feedback and enhanced learning outcomes.
